edits.old: Then the pack check reads the same rows for "LITIGATION"
edits.new:
Then the pack check reads the same rows for "LITIGATION"

  Scenario: AC14 The provided operations answer 401 without an authenticated session and 404 for a case that does not exist (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a request for the checklist operation without an authenticated session
    When the request is sent
    Then the system answers with 401
    Then no checklist item list is returned
    Given a request for the checklist of a case that does not exist
    When the request is sent
    Then the system answers with 404

  Scenario: AC15 The refresh activity of JOB-12 is retried and then times out (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the refresh activity of JOB-12 runs on queue "rwb-document"
    Given the activity does not complete within its timeout
    When the activity runs for case "RW-2026-000789"
    Then the activity is retried
    Then after the retry limit the activity fails and the failure goes to the platform administrator

  Scenario: AC16 A consumed rwb-case call fails and no flag is written (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock fails the stage read for case "RW-2026-000123"
    When DocumentStored for case "RW-2026-000123" is handled
    Then no case_document_check flag is written
    Then the event is retried
